personality_one_liner: A cinematic, high-end convention hall discovery and booking marketplace with glassmorphism, VIP membership tiers, and instant reservation workflows.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with cinematic padding, compact list gaps, and sticky bottom CTAs with safe area clearance.

dos: Use frosted glass over cinematic backdrop photos
Glass sticky headers over scrolling content
Glass bottom tab bar and modal sheets
donts: Never blur body text or form inputs
Never use low-opacity glass without a dark translucent base tint

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: 1-Tap Demo Login, Social Login, Email/Password JWT auth, and Open Guest Mode
screens.layout: Cinematic dark hero background with gradient scrim, brand wordmark, quick 1-tap role selector, and clean authentication tabs.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Hall Discovery with Pincode Search, category tabs, featured luxury venues, and VIP upgrade banner.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No convention halls found in this pincode' + Reset Filter button

screens.layout: Sticky header with pincode search & profile icon, horizontal category pills, featured hero carousel with glass badges, and vertical venue cards list.

screens.name: HallDetail
screens.purpose: Showcase hall photo gallery, pricing, capacity, star ratings, real-time availability calendar, and direct actions (Call, WhatsApp, Enquiry).

states.loading: Image skeleton loader and detail placeholders
states.error: Failed to load hall data + retry button

screens.layout: Full-bleed cover photo with back button and favorite icon, scrollable details sheet with glassmorphic stats, date slot picker, reviews section, and sticky bottom booking bar.

screens.name: BookingFlow
screens.purpose: Select dates, guest count, add-ons, apply VIP unlock code (GT011103) or Cashfree Pro membership, and confirm reservation.

states.error: Booking conflict or payment validation error message

screens.layout: Step-by-step summary card, VIP code input drawer with instant validation, Cashfree gateway simulation, and success confirmation modal.

screens.name: OwnerDesk
screens.purpose: Owner listing management, incoming enquiries, real-time availability calendar toggle, and booking request approvals.

states.loading: Metrics skeleton and booking list loader
states.empty: Illustration + 'No convention halls or enquiries yet' + Create Listing button
states.error: Failed to sync owner data + retry

screens.layout: Dashboard metrics top bar, active listings horizontal reel, incoming enquiries list with status badges, and quick action FAB for adding new hall.

screens.name: AdminDesk
screens.purpose: Platform admin control panel for venue approvals, VIP usage tracking, user management, and platform analytics.
screens.layout: Tabular control center with stat summary cards, moderation queue with approve/reject actions, and system logs.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User profile, saved favorites, booking history, Pro membership status, and VIP unlock management.

states.empty: No bookings or saved halls found

screens.layout: Header banner with user avatar and VIP badge status, booked events history list, settings rows with glass tinted icons, and logout button.

luxe_interior.alt: Luxurious ballroom arranged for grand event

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the HallFinder mobile app using Glass / Luxe DARK personality with deep obsidian and gold accent tokens.
Implement Hall Discovery & Pincode Filter with real-time matching and category pills.
Support Demo 1-Tap Login, Social Login, Email/Password JWT auth, and Open Guest Mode.
Implement VIP code GT011103 unlock flow and Cashfree Pro membership simulation.
Provide Hall Details, photo gallery, real-time availability calendar, and reviews (Pro write, Free read).
Build Owner Desk and Admin Desk for venue management, enquiry handling, and approvals.
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt, safe areas are respected, and glass blur surfaces use dark translucent backing tints for absolute contrast.
